# Incident Report / Postmortem

## Incident metadata
- ID/date/duration:
- Environment: Testnet only
- Severity/owner:

## Impact
What was affected? Were orders, positions or credentials exposed? Never include secret values.

## Timeline
Use UTC timestamps.

## Detection
Which alert/metric/log revealed it?

## Root cause and contributing factors
Separate confirmed facts from hypotheses.

## Safety response
State changes, entry halt, reconciliation, key rotation if needed, and final verified exchange state.

## Recovery evidence
How was state confirmed? What test proves the fix?

## Corrective actions
| Action | Owner | Due | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|

## Docs/tests to update
Security, API contract, runbook, regression tests, metrics, architecture.
